verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair axis for a data and AI platform, but the pack only describes Databricks as a hosted service (pay-as-you-go pricing, free trial and Free Edition workspaces, Databricks-hosted apps and MCP servers). Nothing documents a deployable, self-managed version of the core product. Local tools such as the CLI, SDK, Databricks Connect and dbt Core are clients that talk to Databricks compute, so they do not count as self-hosting the product.
